W: Hi Mr. Kim, did you receive the updated budget report for the marketing campaign?
M: Yes, I just reviewed it this morning. It looks like travel expenses increased by 10 percent.
W: Right, that's because of the upcoming trade show in Singapore next month.

Attention all passengers waiting to board Flight 402 to Tokyo. Due to a minor mechanical inspection, boarding will be delayed by approximately thirty minutes. We apologize for the inconvenience and invite you to enjoy complimentary refreshments at Gate 14B.

To: All Staff
From: Human Resources
Subject: Annual Health Checkup

Please be reminded that the annual company health checkup will take place next week from Monday to Wednesday. All full-time employees are (11) ___ to register for a time slot through the internal portal before Friday at 5:00 P.M. (12) ___. If you have any dietary restrictions prior to the blood test, our medical partner will send guidelines to your email.

GRAND OPENING: GREENLEAF OFFICE SUPPLIES
Visit our newest branch at 240 Oak Street this Saturday, November 14! The first 50 customers will receive a free leather notebook. Enjoy a 20% discount on all ergonomic chairs and standing desks throughout the weekend. Free delivery is available for orders over $150.
